entities.summary: Bengt Gunnar Richard Ahlfors, is a Finland-Swedish playwright, composer, and former journalist. He is noted for works such as Finns det tigrar i Kongo?, a 1986 play that focused on AIDS pandemic and has since been translated into twenty languages.
